title: GC–EI–MS Annotation Tool
description: Software for tentative electron-ionization gas chromatography–mass spectrometry (GC–EI–MS) library annotation. The latest interface provides one source-verified model, searching 8,455 reference chemical-connectivity identities using weighted EI spectral similarity and a previously developed 12-feature HistGradientBoosting confidence model. Supports single-spectrum and batch CSV annotation, ranked top-ten library candidates, downloadable results, input templates, citation guidance and developer information. Publisher-first14 labels are not independently authenticated chemical identities. Original historical confidence-screening targets are not certified future-error bounds. This release changes the user interface and documentation only; the model, source/index SHA-256, original numerical scoring and thresholds remain unchanged.
